pockets.name: LEI-800 GyrA allosteric pocket
pockets.functionalRole: A horseshoe-like hydrophobic pocket on the DNA-binding surface, distinct from fluoroquinolones.
limitations: The ligand also contacts DNA; monomer-only peptide prediction changes the pocket geometry.
Evidence is for a small hydrophobic molecule, not a peptide.

pockets.name: GyrA fluoroquinolone cleavage-complex site
pockets.functionalRole: Stabilizes the cleaved GyrA-DNA intermediate and blocks religation.
limitations: This is not a pocket on an isolated GyrA monomer.
Peptide conditioning requires explicit DNA and both GyrA chains; current MVP input does not encode that complex.

targets.name: PBP2a family beta-lactam-resistant peptidoglycan transpeptidase, partial

pockets.name: PBP2a transpeptidase active site
pockets.functionalRole: Catalytic Ser403 performs DD-transpeptidation and is acylated by beta-lactams.
limitations: The active site is normally closed/narrow and beta-lactam inhibition is covalent.
Rosetta scores cannot model the beta-lactam acylation mechanism as peptide affinity.

pockets.name: PBP2a ceftaroline/muramate allosteric domain
pockets.functionalRole: Binding propagates a long-range conformational change that opens the transpeptidase active site.
limitations: Structure is S. aureus PBP2a, transferred to the sequence-identical S. epidermidis partial protein.
The allosteric region is broad and conformational; use an ensemble, not a single residue centroid.
